messages:
ria: Pushed an accessibility-focused pass on the first-run checklist and sample-project onboarding. Main ask: how should we announce progress to screen readers when sample projects are provisioned?

ben: thanks — do you mean the live region text that says "Provisioning X" -> "Provisioned"? If so, we should avoid rapid repeated announcements. Use polite aria-live and update only on state transitions.

mika: UX question: should the checklist progress say numeric steps (Step 2 of 5) or percent? Users in research liked fractional progress (2/5). Screen readers prefer explicit wording: "Step 2 of 5: Add sample projects."

ria: good point. I'll switch to "Step N of M" prefix for each checklist row. Also thinking about the sample-project run flow: when user hits "Run with sample data" we provision and then open project view. For SR users we should announce "Project ready" and then focus into the new project's main heading.

sam: implementation detail: if the project view is in a new route, push focus to `#project-title`. Ensure we don't double-announce route change and toast. Maybe delay toast announcement until after focus has moved.

a11y-bot: checklist: 1) checklist rows have `role=list` + `aria-label="Onboarding checklist"`; 2) each row is `role=listitem` with `aria-labelledby` pointing to the text that includes "Step X of Y"; 3) provisioning toast has `aria-live=polite`; 4) when project is ready, set focus to project title and then announce "Project "NAME" is ready." via a visually-hidden live region. Avoid duplicate announcements by muting the toast when routing sets focus.

privacy-bot: reminder: any sample demo that sends example requests must surface telemetry choice. I like the lightweight inline popover approach we used in the last review — but add explicit SR text for the checkbox so screen reader users hear why they are opting in. Eg: `aria-describedby` referencing "This enables anonymous usage metrics; request bodies are never stored."

ben: copy micro-nit: in the popover we currently say "anonymized example requests". Suggest "anonymized example requests (no request bodies stored)" for clarity. Also keep the checkbox label short: "Enable anonymous usage metrics". The longer explanation lives in `aria-describedby`.

mika: mobile layout: when the sample-project tray expands, we must avoid full-screen modal semantics (which trap focus) unless it's an actual modal. Use a slide-up panel with `role=dialog` only on confirm flows. For the tray, prefer `aria-expanded` and keep it in the tab order.

a11y-bot: confirm: slide-up panel should not use `inert` unless it's a modal. Use `aria-hidden` on inerted content. Keep transitions short (250ms) to avoid long announcements.

sam: analytics: track `onboard.checklist_step_viewed`, `sample.tray_opened`, `sample.run_initiated`, `sample.provisioned`, and `telemetry.opt_in`. We'll correlate SR interactions too (e.g., `a11y.tray_opened`) to spot accessibility friction.

ria: UX decision proposal: 
- Use "Step X of Y" prefix on checklist rows (visible + announced).
- Sample-project tray (non-modal) with an explicit "Run with sample data" button.
- On first run show a small confirmation popover containing the unchecked checkbox "Enable anonymous usage metrics" with `aria-describedby` linking to the explanatory text.
- Provisioning flow: polite live-region toast "Provisioning project..." then when project route loads, focus `#project-title` and announce "Project ready" via hidden live region; suppress the toast announcement to avoid duplication.
- Default states: both sample projects and telemetry OFF by default.

ben: +1. Also add a small visual callout on the sample card when checkbox is OFF: "Telemetry disabled" so users see the current state before running.

mika: a11y testing plan: test with NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack; run keyboard-only sessions and a fast-scan with a screen reader to ensure announcements are not noisy. Add automation to run axe-core and manual SR pass in PR checklist.

privacy-bot: final: ensure consent is recorded server-side with fields (`user_id`, `consent_boolean`, `timestamp`, `method`) and that EU accounts block telemetry until consent is given. Also add a Settings -> Privacy toggle that surfaces the recorded choice.

ria: great — I'll push the updated prototype and a small PR with implementation notes + the SR copy strings. I'll include an a11y smoke test checklist in the PR description. Thanks!

sam: one last microcopy: change toast text from "Provisioning..." to "Provisioning sample project..." so it's explicit in SR announcements.

a11y-bot: noted. End thread.
